pages.name: QGA: Alekhine, 4.e3 Bg4 5.Bxc4 e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 used 0-0 shorthand and omitted Qb3 against b7; rewrote it. British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: QGA: Alekhine, 4.e3 Bg4 5.Bxc4 e6 6.h3
pages.notes: Plan 3 said g4 weakens Black's kingside (it loosens White's). Rewrote it; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Alekhine, 4.e3 Bg4 5.Bxc4 e6 6.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the g-file open after gxf3 (half-open) and ignored Qxf3. Rewrote it.

pages.name: QGA: Alekhine, 4.e3 Bg4 5.Bxc4 e6 6.Qb3
pages.notes: Plan 3 pressed a d5-pawn Black does not have. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Mannheim, 4...c6
pages.notes: Overview had 4...c6 supporting a d5-pawn Black does not have; plan 2 played ...e6 before getting the c8-bishop out. Rewrote overview clause and both plans.

pages.name: QGA: Mannheim, 4...c6, 5.Qxc4 Bf5 6.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 called a3 and b4 a minority attack; plan 4 wrote Nh4 as a Black move. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Mannheim, 4...Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 used 0-0 shorthand; plan 3 called the c-file controlled rather than half-open. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Mannheim, Main Line, 10.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...g5 with White's bishop on g5. Rewrote it; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Mannheim Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Be2/g3+Bg2 shorthand; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 4.Nc3 a6 5.a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a rook on d1 pressing a d5-pawn that is not there; plan 2 developed the bishop to b7 after 5.a4 stops ...b5. Rewrote both; British spelling.
